question: Hanish starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the north. He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km, turns right and drives 17 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90-degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Hanish starts from Point A and drives 12 km towards the north.

He then takes a right turn, drives 8 km,

turns right and drives 17 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 10 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 5 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c69cd420c65977e77c8b6082896fd249645a741a778808d3716de3db01e49dee.png] 

So, **2 km to the east** in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
